notes.title: Rue Valley Release Date is Revealed!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, time-loopers![/p][p][/p][p]Today is a super-exciting day for us at Emotion Spark Studio, because we are finally ready to announce the release date for Rue Valley!
[/p][previewyoutube="dDD2IlPIDcY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’ve been working on Rue Valley since 2020, and seeing the game taking its final shape feels incredible! Almost all of its content is ready now, and we are finishing what little’s left to be done. Then we will focus on polishing the game and fixing bugs and porting issues—because Rue Valley is also coming to consoles![/p][p][/p][p]Some of you have asked us whether we plan to open preorders. The short answer is no, we want to finish the development and release the game first. But if you want to help, please wishlist Rue Valley, subscribe to our YouTube channel, follow us on X and Bluesky, join our Subreddit and Discord server—and of course, tell your friends about Rue Valley and its free demo! All this helps people find out about Rue Valley, and word of the mouth in this day and age can mean the world.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you’ve enjoyed the new trailer for Rue Valley, and that you are already planning Mister Harrow’s personality. Thank you all for your support and see you in Rue Valley on 11/11/2025! [/p][p][/p][p]Love,[/p][p]Emotion Spark Studio[/p][p]
[/p]
